brief:
A nine-month-old Palestinian infant has died from extreme cold in Khan Younis, southern Gaza, Palestine News Network reported Friday, marking the first recorded cold-related death in the Strip this winter. Medical sources confirmed the death as temperatures drop across the territory.

Displaced Palestinians sheltering in Gaza lack adequate heating and shelter during winter months, leaving families vulnerable to harsh weather conditions as the humanitarian crisis persists.
dek: Gaza / PNN / A nine-month-old Palestinian infant has died from extreme cold in Khan Younis, southern Gaza, medical sources reported Friday, marking the first cold-related death recorded in the Gaza Strip this winter.
title: Nine-month-old dies of cold in Gaza as winter worsens
